<!-- The problem in a sentence or two, with steps to reproduce if it's a bug. Link the issue if there is one. -->

<!-- How this fixes it. If it touches several parts, say why each is needed for this one problem. -->

## Verification

<!-- What you checked and what you saw: focused tests, manual steps, which OS and VPN type.

Changes to the window need before and after screenshots. -->
